info.title: Qwen_Image
info.description: Create images from text or edit supported reference images with Qwen Image, then retrieve the finished image URLs. Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples. Start: https://platform.acedata.cloud/services/9a33d10b-9f5d-438f-9701-c34906a2d891?from=coze

n.description: Number of output images, from 1 to 6.

size.description: Output dimensions, pixel area must be between 512×512 and 2048×2048.

prompt_extend_mode.description: Prompt enhancement mode; agent is text-to-image only.

post.description: Qwen Image image generation and editing interface. Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/qwen-image-images Submit once with async=true. Retain task_id and poll the matching task tool; a task ID is not a completed result. Do not resubmit while pending.
